subject: Post-call recap & procurement path — decision owners and SLA ask (CareStream Health)
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Erin Bowen <erin.bowen@carestream.health>, Procurement <procure@carestream.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & procurement path — decision owners and SLA ask (CareStream Health)

Hi Erin — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Summary of today's discovery: CareStream is evaluating a 3-month pilot (10k API calls/day) to validate clinic intake triage and documentation summarization. Primary success metrics: accuracy on extraction tasks, and median token latency <300ms p50.
- Decision makers you called out: Linda Park (CFO) as economic owner, Michael Zhou (IT Security) & Procurement team for SOW/terms. Please confirm if Linda is the final signatory or if legal will also route approvals.
- Procurement asks noted: SOC2 attestation, data retention terms, and template SOW. You mentioned a compressed procurement window (target signing by end of July).

Attachments I’m sharing: SOW_draft_v0.3.pdf (pilot scope & proposed SLA), pricing_summary.xlsx (pilot pricing + ramp), SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf.

Two items I want to surface so we can align internally: 
1) SLA concession request: you asked whether we can reduce retention of inference logs from 90 days to 30 days for the pilot and accept a 48-hour outage response SLA (rather than our standard 4-hour P1 response) in exchange for a pilot discount.
2) Discount ask: you signaled expectation of an introductory pilot discount; Erin, can you confirm the internal threshold (e.g., authorized by Linda or does this need exec approval)?

Proposed immediate next steps: 
- Erin / Procurement: confirm who will sign (Linda or legal) and share any SOW redlines by Wed 6/16.
- Redwood internal: Ben/Neha, can you review the attached SOW and SOC2 and advise on maximum allowable pilot discount and whether we can provisionally agree to a 30-day retention + 48-hr P1 response for a limited pilot? If we need a formal exception, outline what approvers we need to loop in.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call tomorrow afternoon to move this along.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: SOW_draft_v0.3.pdf (pdf), pricing_summary.xlsx (xlsx), SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf (pdf)

From: Erin Bowen <erin.bowen@carestream.health>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@carestream.health>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & procurement path — decision owners and SLA ask (CareStream Health)

Thanks Sean — great summary. Quick answers inline: 

- Signatory: Linda Park (CFO) will approve commercial terms; legal will do a standard review but they don't sign. So Linda is the economic buyer and final approver for pilot commercials.
- Timeline: Procurement is aiming to have paperwork complete by 7/28; they need final SOW and SOC2 evidence by 7/8 to fit legal review cycles.
- Security ask: Michael (IT Security) flagged the retention change — reducing to 30 days for pilot is acceptable, but they require a logged exception approval and a short justification (data minimization during eval). They will also request an IP whitelist for our test environment.

I attached the RFP fragment they requested (CareStream_RFP_v1.docx) and added a short procurement note in the doc.

We can accept a commercial pilot discount but Linda needs a recommended discount and an explicit expiration on the offer (e.g., pilot discount valid if signed by 7/15). Can you provide the recommended pilot pricing and the operational guardrails we would need?

Erin Bowen
Director of Product Operations | CareStream Health
erin.bowen@carestream.health

Attachments: CareStream_RFP_v1.docx

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-call recap & procurement path — decision owners and SLA ask (CareStream Health)

Folks — forwarding the thread with CareStream responses. Key asks we need internal alignment on: 

1) Pilot discount recommendation for CFO (Linda Park). Sales view: suggest a 25% introductory pilot discount on the pilot ARR-equivalent; we believe this is reasonable to secure a fast signature and the chance to scale.
2) SLA / retention exception: they want 30-day retention (vs our standard 90) and 48-hr P1 response window for the pilot. Security wants a logged exception plus IP whitelisting.
3) Timing: they want SOC2 evidence and final SOW by 7/8 to meet their 7/28 signing target.

Requested from you both: 
- Ben: can you confirm commercial approval (max discount we can offer without escalating to revenue ops / leadership)?
- Neha: can you confirm whether security can approve a 30-day retention / 48hr P1 exception for a 3-month pilot and what the formal exception process looks like (who signs it). If Legal needs to sign a separate exception, note that in the reply.

I'm proposing a short internal call Thurs 6/17 at 11am PT if you both are free — to lock the recommended offer before I send to Linda.

Thanks,
Sean
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Sean — thanks for the context and the attachments. Quick internal decision rubric: 

- Pilot discount: we can approve up to a 20% pilot discount at AE level for a short-term proof-of-value. Anything beyond 20% requires RevOps sign-off and VP approval. Recommend we offer 20% with a defined renewal price point and a 30-day opt-out for CareStream at the end of the pilot.

- SLA / retention exception: security (Neha) will need to sign a documented exception. Neha — if you confirm the 30-day retention + 48hr P1 response is acceptable for a 3-month pilot with IP whitelist and no PHI persisted beyond the pilot, Redwood Legal should be able to approve a one-off exception. If Legal requires an indemnity change we will escalate. Please outline the exception form and approver list (security lead + Head of Legal).

- Docs/timeline: we should return an annotated SOW with tracked redlines by 6/24 to give CareStream time before their 7/8 cutoff. Also propose the pilot discount offer expires 7/15 (gives Linda time but forces decision).

If Neha confirms the exception flow, I will prepare a short internal approval packet (SOW redlines, security exception form, discount approval memo) and route to RevOps only if we need >20%.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Cc: RevOps if required
